document_summary: Justia mirror of N.J.S.A. 46:8-26 (2025), the application-of-act section of New Jersey's security deposit statute, covering New Jersey statewide.

rules.title: NJ Security Deposit Act: application of act
rules.requirement: The security deposit act applies to all rental premises or units used for dwelling purposes. Owner-occupied premises with not more than two rental units are excluded unless the tenant gives the landlord 30 days written notice invoking the act.
rules.coverage_conditions: All rental premises or units used for dwelling purposes.
rules.exemptions: Owner-occupied premises with not more than two rental units, where the tenant has failed to provide 30 days written notice to the landlord invoking the provisions of the act.
rules.quoted_span: The provisions of this act shall apply to all rental premises or units used for dwelling purposes except owner-occupied premises with not more than two rental units where the tenant has failed to provide 30 days written notice to the landlord invoking the provisions of this act.
rules.extraction_notes: Scope section only. The headline deposit cap and rules are in other sections of the act (e.g. 46:8-19 et seq.). The history note says L.1967, c. 265, s. 8, eff. Jan. 1, 1968, so that date is used. Amendments were L.1968 c. 46 (eff. 1968-05-22), L.1971 c. 223 (eff. 1971-06-21) and L.1979 c. 28 (eff. 1979-02-22). The source is a secondary mirror (Justia).
